# The Parallel

> Coffee and toast bar on a backstreet in Perth CBD, Western Australia (143 Barrack St, Perth WA 6000). Specialty coffee, artisan toasties, dine in and takeaway.

- Hours: Monday–Friday 7am–3pm, Saturday 8am–2pm, Sunday closed.
- Order online: https://theparallelonline.square.site
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theparallelinperth

## Pages
- [Home, menu and location](https://theparallel.com.au/): menu of toasties and drinks with prices, reviews, map and hours.
- [Links](https://theparallel.com.au/links.html): order online, Instagram and reviews.
